title: Day-One Checklist for New Employees
content:
Day-One Checklist at NovaTech Solutions:

Before You Arrive:
- You will receive a 'Welcome to NovaTech' email 2 days before joining with your temporary credentials
- Download and review the Employee Handbook (link in welcome email)
- Bring: 2 passport-sized photos, original ID proof (Aadhaar/Passport), PAN card, educational certificates, bank passbook/cancelled cheque

Day 1 Morning:
1. Report to Reception, Ground Floor, A-Wing (ask for HR Onboarding)
2. Collect your visitor badge (upgraded to permanent badge in 3–5 days)
3. Meet your HR Onboarding Buddy (assigned in your welcome email)
4. Onboarding session: 9:30 AM – 12:00 PM in the Training Room (Floor 1, Room T-02)
   - Company overview and culture
   - Policies walkthrough (HR, IT, Security)
   - Benefits enrollment introduction

Day 1 Afternoon:
5. Meet your manager and team for a welcome lunch (manager will book a lunch slot)
6. Set up your workstation with IT help (call ext. 2020 or visit IT Room G-02)
7. Attend IT Orientation: 2:00 PM – 3:30 PM (IT sets up your accounts and laptop)
8. Complete mandatory online trainings (links sent to work email): Security Awareness, Code of Conduct, POSH

First Week:
- Schedule 1:1s with all key team members
- Review the 30-60-90 day plan with your manager
- Get your permanent employee ID card from HR (Room A-108) — bring your photo
- Enroll in benefits (health insurance nomination) within first 30 days

title: IT Equipment Allocation for New Employees
content:
IT Equipment Allocation at NovaTech Solutions:

Standard Equipment Provided on Day 1:
- Laptop (see hardware policy for your role's standard model)
- Laptop bag
- Power adapter and cables
- Mouse and keyboard (at your desk workstation)
- Headset (standard Jabra Evolve 2 model)

Setup Process:
- IT team sets up your laptop during the Day 1 IT Orientation session
- You will receive your laptop with Windows/macOS pre-installed and company MDM configured
- First login uses your temporary credentials from the welcome email
- IT will walk you through the setup checklist (password change, MFA, VPN, OneDrive)

Additional Equipment (request via IT Portal after Day 1):
- Additional monitor: 1 per employee, no approval required
- Docking station: Request via IT Portal
- Ergonomic accessories (wrist pad, vertical mouse): 1 item, no approval required

Personal Equipment Policy:
- Personal phones: Use for work communication if needed; set up work email using the Email on Mobile guide
- Personal laptop: Can be used for WFH supplementary work; do not install company software on personal laptops

Equipment Return on Exit:
- All equipment must be returned on or before last working day
- Asset list will be provided by IT for verification
- Lost/damaged equipment may attract a penalty (see Hardware Policy)

Your Equipment Serial Numbers:
- Recorded by IT during setup and linked to your employee ID
- View your assets: IT Portal > 'My Assets'

title: Benefits Enrollment During Onboarding
content:
Benefits Enrollment for New Employees at NovaTech Solutions:

You have 30 days from your joining date to enroll in benefits. Missing the window means waiting until the next annual open enrollment in October.

Health Insurance (Group Mediclaim):
1. HR Portal > 'Benefits' > 'Health Insurance Enrollment'
2. Add dependents: Spouse, children (under 25), OR parents (choose one group)
3. Upload: Dependency proof (marriage certificate for spouse, birth certificate for children)
4. Select: Base policy only OR base + top-up (INR 3,500/year, employee-paid)
5. Insurance cards will be mailed to your home address within 21 days

Group Term Life Insurance:
- Automatic enrollment (no action needed)
- Add nominee: HR Portal > 'Benefits' > 'Life Insurance Nominee'
- Nomination document must be signed and submitted to HR Room A-108

Group Personal Accident:
- Automatic enrollment
- No further action required

NPS (National Pension Scheme):
- Voluntary: HR Portal > 'Benefits' > 'NPS Enrollment'
- NovaTech contributes INR 1,000/month if employee contributes INR 1,000/month
- Tax benefit under Sec 80CCD(1B)

Flex Benefits Plan:
- Employees can allocate part of their CTC to flexible components (LTA, fuel, books & periodicals)
- Optimize for tax savings
- HR Portal > 'Benefits' > 'Flex Benefits Declaration'
- Must be declared at the start of financial year (April)

For assistance: Contact hr-benefits@novatech.com

title: Buddy Programme for New Employees
content:
Buddy Programme at NovaTech Solutions:

Every new employee at NovaTech is assigned a Buddy — an experienced employee who helps you navigate your first 90 days.

What Your Buddy Does:
- Answers informal questions about culture, processes, and team dynamics
- Introduces you to key people in your team and cross-functional colleagues
- Shares unwritten tips about how things really work at NovaTech
- Checks in weekly in your first month, fortnightly in months 2–3
- Helps you understand your 30-60-90 day plan

Your Buddy Assignment:
- Assigned in your welcome email (Name, Teams handle, calendar link)
- Your buddy is NOT your manager — they're a peer or a senior colleague
- Contact them any time via Teams chat or email

First Meeting Agenda (suggested):
- Coffee/lunch in the first 3 days
- Discussion: Role overview, team members to meet, tools to learn, informal culture tips
- Exchange contact details and set a weekly check-in cadence

Feedback:
- After 90 days, HR sends a Buddy Programme survey — your feedback improves the programme

If You Want to Be a Buddy:
- Email hr@novatech.com with your name, role, and team
- Training: 2-hour 'How to Be a Great Buddy' workshop offered quarterly
- Buddy experience is recognized in performance reviews under 'Culture and Collaboration'

Multiple Buddies:
- For senior hires (L5+), a cross-functional buddy (from a different department) is also assigned

title: Probation Period Policy
content:
Probation Period Policy at NovaTech Solutions:

Duration:
- Standard probation: 6 months from the date of joining
- Extended probation: Up to 3 additional months (HR discretion, if performance needs improvement)
- Some roles (senior engineering, management): 3-month probation

During Probation:
- Same access to company resources as regular employees
- WFH not applicable (must come to office every working day)
- Performance is closely monitored with monthly feedback from manager
- No eligibility for internal transfers during probation

Probation Confirmation:
- Manager submits 'Probation Confirmation' form to HR 30 days before probation ends
- HR reviews and sends confirmation letter to employee
- If no action taken by HR, employee is considered confirmed (automatic confirmation rule)

Extension of Probation:
- Communicated in writing 30 days before probation end
- Specific improvement areas documented in extension letter
- Maximum total probation: 9 months

Termination During Probation:
- 2-week notice from either side during probation (vs. 30–90 days for confirmed employees)
- NovaTech may terminate without notice if gross misconduct is involved

Benefits During Probation:
- Health insurance: Effective from Day 1
- Leave: CL and SL available from Day 1 (EL accrues but cannot be taken during probation)
- PF: Contributions begin from first month

Probation Completion Ceremony:
- Team celebration is encouraged — manager coordinates with HR for a confirmation gift

title: Employee ID Card and Access Badge
content:
Employee ID Card and Access Badge at NovaTech Solutions:

Temporary Access Badge:
- Given on Day 1 at reception
- Provides access to main office areas (common spaces, cafeteria, your floor)
- Valid for 7 days

Permanent Employee ID Card:
- Ready within 5–7 business days of joining
- Collect from HR Room A-108 (bring an original ID for first collection)
- Contains: Photo, name, employee ID, department, emergency contact of HR
- Functions as: Access badge for all office areas + printer ID tap + visitor sign-in

Access Levels:
- General access: All common areas, your floor, cafeteria, reception
- Restricted areas: Server room, finance floor, HR records room — separate access request needed
- To request additional access: IT Portal > 'Access Request' > 'Physical Access'

Lost ID Card:
- Report to HR and IT immediately
- Lost card is deactivated remotely within 30 minutes
- Replacement cost: INR 200 (second loss)
- Use visitor badge until replacement is ready (2 business days)

For Visitors and Contractors:
- All visitors must sign in at reception with valid photo ID
- Contractors get a 90-day contractor badge (orange color)
- All visitors must be escorted in restricted areas by a NovaTech employee

Weekend Access:
- Enabled by default for confirmed employees
- Request via IT Portal for temporary workers

title: Office Facilities and Amenities
content:
Office Facilities at NovaTech Solutions (Bengaluru HQ):

Address: NovaTech Tower, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur, Bengaluru – 560 103

Floor Guide:
- Ground Floor: Reception, Security, IT Help Desk (G-02), Meeting Rooms G-01 to G-05
- Floor 1: Engineering Team A, Training Rooms (T-01, T-02), IT Lab
- Floor 2: Engineering Team B, Product, Design, Nursing Room (2-45)
- Floor 3: Marketing, Sales, HR (A-108), Finance
- Floor 4: Senior Leadership, Executive Boardroom
- Terrace: Cafeteria, Recreation Area, Open seating

Cafeteria:
- Breakfast: 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM
- Lunch: 12:30 PM – 2:30 PM
- Evening Snacks: 4:30 PM – 5:30 PM
- Daily menu on the NovaTech intranet (Homepage > Cafeteria Menu)
- Cost: Subsidized (INR 50 breakfast, INR 100 lunch) — deducted from salary monthly

Other Amenities:
- Recreation room (Terrace): Foosball, TT table, PS5 — open 6 PM onwards
- Library corner (Floor 3): Books and publications available for borrowing
- Mother's room (Floor 2, Room 2-45): Private, air-conditioned, refrigerator available
- Prayer/meditation room (Floor 1): Available all day, no booking needed
- First Aid: Each floor has a first aid kit; trained first aiders marked on floor map
- Doctor on-site: Tuesdays and Thursdays 2–5 PM (Ground Floor clinic)

Parking:
- 2-wheeler: First come first serve (80 slots)
- 4-wheeler: Assigned slots for L5+ employees; others on waitlist (HR Portal > 'Parking Waitlist')
- Cab drop/pick-up zone: South entrance
